instruction: Navigate to the contact information page on the Ticketek website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Ticketek homepage to the contact information page. Evaluator checks if the active tab URL contains 'contact' pattern, indicating successful navigation to the contact page.
metadata.verification_notes: Using existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric. Pattern 'contact' will match URLs like '/contact-us', '/contact', etc.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses URL pattern matching to verify navigation to contact page
Pattern 'contact' appropriately matches contact information page URLs (e.g., /contact, /contact-us, /help/contact)
Getter (get_active_tab_info) successfully extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly performs regex pattern matching on URL
Complete coverage: instruction requires navigation to contact page, evaluator verifies URL contains 'contact'
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: get_active_tab_info reloads the target URL which could cause issues if page redirects differently on reload, but unlikely to be a problem for a simple contact page. Consider using get_active_url_from_accessTree directly if reload causes issues.
